features.text: PDAC APPROVED L1820: Elastic knee orthosis with condylar pads and joints for patellar tracking control.
INTEGRATED LATERAL BUTTRESS: Provides targeted pressure to stabilize patella and prevent displacement.
THERAPEUTIC NEOPRENE SUPPORT: Delivers compression warmth to relieve pain and stiffness.
ADJUSTABLE STRAP SYSTEM: Customizable top and bottom compression for secure fit.
SLIM LOW-PROFILE BUILD: Designed for daily comfort under clothing without limiting movement.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
